sentences.en: One fifth of the earth's surface is covered by permafrost.
sentences.zh: 地球表面的五分之一被永久冻土覆盖。

sentences.en: Today is the fifth day of continual stock price decline.
sentences.zh: 今天是股票连续下跌的第五天。

sentences.en: When you get on the highway, shift into fifth gear.
sentences.zh: 当你上高速公路时，换到五挡。
